notes.title: Online Multiplayer Servers Closing
notes.content:
Rock n' Rush online multiplayer servers were closed today.

Since the game never took off, the online servers were past due to be closed.

Thanks to everyone that played the game online with their friends!

Single player and local multiplayer are still playable.
